correctness.rationale: For H at least 2 and n positive, nonperiodic exterior points are excluded, each word contraction has a unique periodic fixed point, and sorted equal-mass cylinders make the within-cylinder coupling optimal. The signed affine translation recurrence gives the exact atomic mean. The conditional absolute-deviation identity and invariance of the complete fixed-point census under f produce the claimed W1 identity and its expansion. Boundary H=2 and exact CDF discrepancy are checked. A standalone checker reproduces forty finite exact-rational cases, but the analytic argument proves the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The 2021 generalized-tent primary article explicitly motivates comparing the Cantor repeller with distributions of periodic points. The complete fixed-point census is a canonical finite dynamical approximation. An exact W1 error, with positive sharp leading coefficient, cancellation of the second-order correction, and exact Kolmogorov discrepancy, provides a calibrated quantitative benchmark; these geometric quantities are not supplied by known symbol coding, finite enumerations or individual-cycle barycenters. The scope does not claim to resolve single-primitive-orbit distribution.
